flags.text: Manufacture also keeps this block separate from two other physical classes already documented in the [archaeological-setting audit](../2026-10-20-archaeological-setting/REPORT.md). H-1727–H-1766 are impressions stamped into vessel walls before ceramic firing. H-1719–H-1724 are separate clay tags bearing seal impressions, while H-1725 is an unbaked jar stopper. Their impressions and attachment possibilities belong to different carrier histories. The present tablets are separately carved stone objects that were subsequently fired.
